READING

**The fixed cost shared by both courses**

The learning-curve bill of GBP 27,072 (280 excess remakes × GBP 96) is identical under either course. I set it aside when comparing the two.

---

**What KIRKBANE actually costs**

*Overtime: GBP 44,000.* This is the largest moveable number in the whole analysis. It is paid up front and with certainty.

*Crossing remakes under KIRKBANE: near zero.* All technicians move on the same date. Kessendale can be retired that morning. No case begins on one system and needs to be finished on another.

*Quality exposure to practices: severe and simultaneous.* Ten technicians, each handling roughly 54 units per month, running at 11.4 % for the first 300 units. In January 2027 the lab's overall remake rate spikes to something around 10 % — roughly three times par — and all forty practices see it in the same month. That is not a small operational fluctuation; it is a reputational event. Practice trust, once shaken, does not appear on a cost schedule but it does appear in revenue.

---

**What AVENSWOOD actually costs**

*Overtime: GBP 0.* The phased pace lets the nine technicians still on Kessendale carry output while each cohort climbs its curve.

*Crossing remakes: real, but bounded.* The pilot pair generated 40 crossing remakes in four months. AVENSWOOD runs two systems for nine months, so the exposure window is 2.25× longer. But the "mixing intensity" — the product of technicians on each system simultaneously — is not constant. It peaks in months one to three (5 new, 7 old), then declines as each cohort crosses. Working through the mixing fractions, the expected crossing-remake count over nine months is roughly 110–120. At GBP 96 each, that is approximately GBP 10,500–11,500. Call it GBP 12,000 to be conservative.

*Dual shade library: a real operational burden for nine months, but unquantified.* It is a management nuisance, not a structural risk, because practices work from the lab's library and only one of the two systems is new to each technician at any point.

*Quality exposure to practices: distributed and manageable.* At most three or four technicians are on the steep part of the curve at any time. Three-quarters of the bench sits at 3.1 % throughout. The remake spike any individual practice sees is modest and brief, not a laboratory-wide event.

---

**Comparative arithmetic**

| Item | AVENSWOOD | KIRKBANE |
|---|---|---|
| Learning-curve remakes | GBP 27,072 | GBP 27,072 |
| Overtime | GBP 0 | GBP 44,000 |
| Crossing remakes (estimated) | ~GBP 11,500 | ~GBP 0 |
| **Total incremental** | **~GBP 38,572** | **~GBP 71,072** |

The gap is roughly GBP 32,500 in AVENSWOOD's favour on the direct cost figures alone. The crossing-remake estimate would need to be almost four times higher — around 460 additional remakes over nine months — to close that gap. That is not plausible.

---

**The timeline check**

Under AVENSWOOD the last technician moves to the new system on 2027-10-04. Kessendale can be retired at that point, eight months before the 2028-06-30 support deadline. Both courses satisfy the deadline comfortably.

---

**What tips the balance**

The GBP 44,000 overtime payment is certain under KIRKBANE. The crossing-remake cost under AVENSWOOD is real but is plausibly one-quarter of that. The simultaneous quality event inflicted on forty practices under KIRKBANE carries an unquantified but non-trivial tail risk. Peer support under AVENSWOOD is an additional buffer. None of the KIRKBANE arguments — speed, single shade library, no crossing remakes — closes the GBP 32,000+ gap.

READING
The phased AVENSWOOD course saves the certain GBP 44,000 overtime cost and avoids a simultaneous, practice-visible remake spike, while its extra crossing-remake liability (estimated at roughly GBP 11,500 over nine months of dual operation) is too small to close the gap; KIRKBANE's advantages are real but do not come close to justifying a cost premium of approximately GBP 32,000.

CALL
AVENSWOOD

GROUNDS
The GBP 44,000 overtime cost under KIRKBANE is certain and roughly four times larger than the plausible crossing-remake liability that dual-system operation adds to AVENSWOOD, and KIRKBANE also concentrates a practice-visible quality shock across all forty practices simultaneously.
